description: 5 real third-party company names (HIMS, Mindful, Calm, Headspace, BetterHelp) rendered as styled <span> elements implying real partnerships that do not exist. Trademark/misleading-advertising risk; contrast 1.5:1 fails WCAG AA.
fix: Replace with neutral placeholders or real <Image> logos with permission. Increase opacity to 60%+. Add aria-hidden=true. If kept, rewrite caption to 'Built to integrate with leading platforms'.

description: All 4 Learn more CTAs target /features#... but no app/features/page.tsx exists. 404 on click.
fix: Create app/features/page.tsx with anchor sections OR redirect CTAs to /services or /about.

description: Two role=tab regions coexist on same activeIndex state but neither wrapped in role=tablist. 4 top tabs have aria-selected but no aria-controls. Accordion lacks aria-expanded.
fix: Wrap 4 top buttons in <div role=tablist aria-orientation=horizontal> and add aria-controls. Convert accordion to Disclosure: add aria-expanded, role=region. Add arrow-key nav.

description: 8 occurrences of animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-N. globals.css has no @keyframes, tailwindcss-animate not installed. Animations silently no-op. prefers-reduced-motion contract broken.
fix: Install tailwindcss-animate OR define keyframes locally in globals.css + add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) override.

description: No export const metadata or generateMetadata. Inherits 30-char title and 56-char description from layout - far below 120-160 char target. No OG, Twitter, canonical, keywords.
fix: Add page-specific metadata: title (anonymous peer support keyword, <=60 chars), description (120-160 chars), keywords[], alternates.canonical, openGraph, twitter.

description: Both files absent. Search engines have no crawl hints and no discoverable list of routes.
fix: Add apps/web/src/app/robots.ts (MetadataRoute.Robots) and apps/web/src/app/sitemap.ts enumerating public marketing routes.

description: No JSON-LD on homepage even though apps/web/src/components/seo/ ships 4 JSON-LD components. Brand has no schema.org identity attached.
fix: Create apps/web/src/components/seo/OrganizationJsonLd.tsx emitting Organization schema and render in page.tsx.

description: .env file present in working tree containing SESSION_SERVICE_SECRET, SESSION_ANONYMISATION_KEY, SUDO_TOKEN_SECRET, HANDLE_DERIVATION_KEY, SAFETY_SERVICE_SECRET, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, HOST_ACCESS_CODE.
fix: Run git log --all --full-history -- .env. If any commit shows .env content, rotate every secret and remove file from history with git filter-repo --path .env --invert-paths.

description: const secret = process.env.HOST_ACCESS_CODE || 'HIPS-HOST-2025' - if env is misconfigured in production, attacker with source access bypasses host auth.
fix: Replace literal default with throw new Error('HOST_ACCESS_CODE required') in production. Rotate secret. Remove from KNOWN_PLACEHOLDERS.

description: Hardcoded 12400+ sessions, Zero identity breaches, 98% report feeling safer, 4.9 stars, Trusted by 12400+ people in crisis, attributed quote from Marcus T. - none sourced.
fix: Replace every static number with CMS-driven field. Replace attributed quote with verified consent-based attribution or remove. Block from homepage until sourced.

description: 12400+ Safe Sessions, 8200+ Active Participants, 45k+ Support Hours, 2100+ Scholarships - all hardcoded.
fix: Same as GAP-010. Verify with real data or stub as TBD before adding to homepage.

description: 5 testimonials use full first+last names (Marcus Chen, Sarah Williams, James Rivera, Dr. Emily Foster, Angela Torres). Contradicts H.I.P.S. anonymity value proposition.
fix: Replace all names with anonymized initials and roles (e.g. M.C., Peer Support Participant).

description: rounded-pill and shadow-soft not registered in globals.css. Falls back to default Tailwind radius and shadow.
fix: Define --radius-pill: 9999px and --shadow-soft in @theme OR replace rounded-pill with rounded-full and shadow-soft with shadow-sm/md.

description: No Strict-Transport-Security header emitted. Production traffic vulnerable to downgrade attacks.
fix: Add header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload (gated on isDev=false).

description: Two-column grid allocates 500px of empty vertical space on right at md+ viewports. Empty <div> produces visible empty column on desktop and forces tall scroll on mobile.
fix: Populate the right column with hero illustration/mockup, OR restructure to single-column hero. At minimum wrap min-h-[500px] in md:.

description: opacity-30 on primary-colored text drops effective contrast below 3:1 (large text) or 4.5:1 (normal). In light mode primary #213d53 at 30% on white = ~1.5:1 - fails WCAG AA.
fix: Increase to opacity-60, OR use text-text-muted instead of text-primary opacity-30, AND add a high-contrast surface wrapper.

description: Hero h1 and supporting paragraph rendered over photographic bg with only bg-gradient-to-t from-primary/20 overlay. 20% primary overlay too weak; contrast fails WCAG AA on bright areas.
fix: Strengthen overlay (e.g. bg-gradient-to-b from-black/60 via-black/20 to-transparent) and switch muted text to white/90 with text-shadow, OR move h1 outside image to flat background.

description: New label uses text-[9px], supporting line uses text-[10px]. Both fall below 12px WCAG minimum.
fix: Replace with text-xs (12px) at minimum, OR text-sm (14px) for the supporting line.

description: text-[10px] on the How It Works badge. Same a11y concern as GAP-104.
fix: Bump to text-xs.

description: Partnering with leading mental health organizations is text-[10px].
fix: Bump to text-xs.

section: How It Works CTA identical to Hero CTA
description: Both primary CTAs are bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-accent and both route to /services. Two identical CTAs to same target within 600px vertical scroll.
fix: Differentiate - e.g. secondary action on lower CTA (Browse services / See all sessions) pointing to a different route.

description: First Anonymous Peer Support Network Live is a superlative. No evidence the platform is the first such network. Legally/ethically risky.
fix: Soften to A new standard in anonymous peer support OR Now live: anonymous peer support.

description: .hips-drawer z-index 60 and .hips-nav z-index 50. .hips-nav creates backdrop-filter stacking context, drawer can render UNDER blurred nav on some browsers.
fix: Raise .hips-nav z-index to 70 when drawer is open OR add body[data-drawer-open=true] .hips-nav { z-index: 40 } rule.

description: Three Google Fonts load with no preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com. Each font file pays full DNS+TLS+TCP round-trip before first byte.
fix: Add <link rel=preconnect href=https://fonts.gstatic.com crossOrigin=anonymous />. Optionally add <link rel=dns-prefetch> as legacy fallback.

description: LCP element hips_hero.png is 1.7 MB PNG. Next image optimizer converts to AVIF/WebP but source file is 1.7 MB which slows optimizer first-byte and inflates page weight.
fix: Convert /hips_hero.png to WebP/AVIF at build time. Supply smaller srcset tier (mobile JPEG/AVIF < 200KB) for first paint and use as priority source.

description: trust-strip-animations.css imported globally in layout.tsx:9 but only used by TrustStrip which is NOT on the homepage. CSS ships to home as dead code (27 lines).
fix: Move the @import of trust-strip-animations.css to be a local import inside TrustStrip.tsx, OR convert to CSS Module.

description: No /og/home route. apps/web/src/app/og/services/[slug]/route.tsx exists; homepage has no equivalent. Social shares of home URL fall back to missing image.
fix: Add apps/web/src/app/og/home/route.tsx (mirror services/[slug]/ pattern) producing 1200x630 PNG, reference ${SITE_URL}/og/home in openGraph.images from GAP-005.

description: Layout-level H.I.P.S. Foundation Platform (30 chars) underuses SERP real estate and has no primary keyword. Sibling pages set keywords[].
fix: Ensure page title includes anonymous peer support and stays <= 60 chars. Add keywords[] (see GAP-005).

description: Footer uses <h2> for column titles (Services, Organization, Legal) which sit OUTSIDE home <main>. Creates logical h2 outside document outline.
fix: Change Footer.tsx:63 from <h2> to non-semantic <span role=presentation> OR <h3> within <section> with visually-hidden <h2> Site links.

description: Home only links to /services /opportunities /demo-room plus FeatureTabs Learn more. No link to /about /donate /crisis /contact /privacy /terms from home - pages exist (Footer has them) but are buried two clicks deep.
fix: Add small More link set after FeatureTabs section: About the foundation, Crisis resources, Donate. OR re-prioritize one CTA to /donate on recurring visit.

description: Accordion triggers (lines 102, 142, 181, 220) do not advertise expanded/collapsed state. SR users cannot tell which panel is open or that clicking will open it.
fix: Add aria-expanded={activeIndex === N} to each accordion trigger button. Remove role=tab (per GAP-003) and add role=region aria-labelledby=accordion-N to each panel.

description: If description copy grows past ~4 lines, content is silently clipped.
fix: Replace with dynamic height (measure via ref + useLayoutEffect, OR transition to max-h-[9999px]).

description: Hardcoded https://images.unsplash.com/... URLs leak third-party request, may rate-limit. Three of four photo IDs unverified, may 404.
fix: Move all 4 mockup images to /public/features/*.png and update src. Verify each URL returns 200.

section: FeatureTabs mockup images load on click
description: Tabs 1-3 conditionally rendered only on click. User clicks tab, image starts downloading at click time, flash of empty content in right column.
fix: Add low-res preview/placeholder background-color in container, OR pre-fetch all 4 images on mount, OR use priority on active image and lazy-load others.

description: Selected tab uses bg-accent/10 border-accent/30 shadow-sm; non-selected uses bg-surface border-border. Difference too subtle for at-a-glance recognition.
fix: Add top accent bar (border-t-2 border-accent) OR left indicator dot to active state.

description: Footer brand mark uses HSSS with subline Sanctuary but page is H.I.P.S. Foundation homepage. Hero says H.I.P.S. Foundation. Inconsistent.
fix: Use H.I.P.S. Foundation OR H.I.P.S. / HSSS consistently.

description: Anonymous peer support with mathematical identity decoupling - mathematical identity decoupling not used in user-facing copy elsewhere.
fix: Rewrite in plainer language matching Hero: Anonymous peer support with hard anonymity protocols.

description: No report-uri or report-to in CSP. CSP violations silently dropped - no telemetry on attempted XSS/inline-script abuse.
fix: Add report-to csp-endpoint and/or report-uri /api/csp-report to directives list, and add Report-To header with group named csp-endpoint. Implement /api/csp-report to ingest reports.

description: frame-src does not include https://js.stripe.com. Donate page uses <Elements> from @stripe/react-stripe-js which loads Stripe.js in iframe. CSP would block Stripe iframe.
fix: Add https://js.stripe.com to frame-src and script-src in production directives. Verify with donate page.

description: Session cookies use HttpOnly, Secure (in prod), SameSite=Lax, Path=/ but no __Host- or __Secure- prefix.
fix: Add __Host- prefix to cookie name. Requires Path=/ (satisfied) and no Domain (satisfied) and Secure (satisfied in prod). Update middleware.ts:169 and all read sites.

description: No export const dynamic, revalidate, or generateStaticParams. Next.js will infer force-static because no data is fetched, but configuration is implicit and fragile.
fix: Add explicit export const dynamic = 'force-static' and export const revalidate = false to lock in static generation.

description: Entire POST/DELETE API surface relies solely on Firebase ID token in HttpOnly cookie. CSRF protection is implicit via SameSite=Lax. State-changing GETs would not be blocked.
fix: Inventory all state-changing API routes. For any that use GET, add CSRF token check or change to POST. For POST routes, rely on SameSite=Lax AND consider double-submit cookie or origin verification.

description: Rate limit applies to all /api/* (100 req / 60 s) using in-memory Map. Breaks horizontal scaling (each node has its own bucket, effective limit = 100 * N_nodes).
fix: Migrate to Redis-backed limiter. Add fallback for when Redis is down (already present). For homepage traffic, no API routes are hit - informational only.

description: AnalyticsTracker mounted in root layout, runs on EVERY page including home. Attaches global document click listener with no gating on first interaction.
fix: Defer AnalyticsTracker mount via requestIdleCallback, OR only attach listener after first user interaction (scroll/click).

description: Focus trap built on drawerRef element but does NOT update first/last focusable elements if drawer children change while open. Uses addEventListener(keydown, onTab) without capture phase.
fix: Add { capture: true } flag and re-query focusable on each Tab key to handle dynamic content.

description: 5 brand names are <span> elements with text inside. Screen readers will read HIMS Mindful Calm Headspace BetterHelp as content.
fix: Add aria-hidden=true to wrapper <div> OR provide accessible label.

description: text-text is not a valid token (alias is text-text-primary).
fix: Replace with text-text-primary and verify in both themes.

description: If tailwindcss-animate not installed, all animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-N classes silently no-op. Root cause of GAP-004.
fix: Verify plugin in package.json; if missing install it OR define keyframes locally.

section: How It Works line fragile % offsets
description: left-[16.67%] right-[16.67%] for 3-column grid assumes equal columns. If grid ever becomes 2 or 4 columns, line will misalign.
fix: Add code comment, OR use inset-x-1/6 for clarity.

description: inside H1 may cause accessibility/SEO issues in some parsers. Line break is visual not semantic.
fix:
Use OR wrap in

if line break is purely visual, OR keep
(acceptable in H1).

description: Verify .hips-dropdown-item and .hips-drawer-link styles have visible focus ring. If they only change text color, keyboard users get no feedback.
fix: Add focus-visible:bg-accent/10 if missing.

description: text-text/60 + opacity-60 = compound 36% effective opacity. Likely fails contrast in dark mode.
fix: Lower one of the two, OR use text-text-muted/80.

description: Footer column headings (Services / Organization / Legal) are <h2> with text-[10px]. Fails AAA readability guideline (12px+ recommended).
fix: Increase to text-xs (12px) OR text-sm (14px) and reduce tracking-brand for legibility.

description: Skip link is focus:px-4 focus:py-2 which produces target well under 44x44px on first reveal.
fix: Add focus:min-h-[44px] focus:min-w-[44px] focus:flex focus:items-center to skip link className.

description: aria-label is Theme: ${label} (click to switch to ${nextLabel}) - click presumes mouse.
fix: Change to Theme: ${label} - activate to switch to ${nextLabel}.

description: Avatar circles use raw hex (#213d53, #2a4a6b) and inline borderLeft style with #D6E0E8. In dark mode dark navy avatars near-invisible on bg-subtle (oklch 0.15).
fix: Replace with bg-primary bg-accent token classes, and border-l border-border for inline style.

description: Hardcoded #213d53 fill embedded in SVG data URL. Opacity 0.015 - almost invisible.
fix: Either parameterize the color, OR accept and document.

description: Body uses pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] but viewport-fit=cover not explicitly set. In iOS Safari browser mode, env(safe-area-inset-bottom) may resolve to 0.
fix: Add export const viewport: Viewport = { width: device-width, initialScale: 1, viewportFit: cover, themeColor: ... }.

description: Hero uses min-h-[80vh] and nested min-h-[70vh]. On iOS Safari 100vh includes URL bar area; 80vh on 667px iPhone gives ~534px content but visible area closer to 460px.
fix: Replace min-h-[80vh] with min-h-[80dvh] (dynamic viewport) - well-supported in iOS Safari 15.4+, Chrome 108+.

description: [data-theme=dark] img:not([data-no-dark]):not([src$=.svg]) applies filter: brightness(0.92) contrast(1.05) to ALL images including hero and unsplash photos.
fix: Add data-no-dark to hero <Image> at page.tsx:19-27 (and probably FeatureTabs right-column images).

description: Uses oklch(from var(--color-bg) l c h / 0.85) - relative-color syntax supported in Chrome 119+, Safari 16.4+, Firefox 128+. Older browsers fall back to opaque.
fix: Add fallback background-color: oklch(var(--color-bg-rgb) / 0.85); behind relative color.

description: Scroll handler uses requestAnimationFrame to throttle setState, but initial onScroll() call invoked synchronously inside effect, can cause setState in middle of React commit phase.
fix: Move initial onScroll() into queueMicrotask OR wrap setIsScrolled in flushSync to avoid hydration mismatch warnings.

description: useAuth() destructured. Navbar is React.memo'd, but useAuth() returns new object on every render of AuthProvider, breaking memoization.
fix: Confirm AuthProvider's useMemo has right dep list, OR drop React.memo from Navbar.

description: Outside click handler uses mousedown to close dropdown, but touch users will need click.
fix: Add touchstart listener in addition to mousedown.

description: If added to homepage later: slide-in animation has no prefers-reduced-motion check.
fix: Add motion-safe: prefix or prefers-reduced-motion check before adding to home.

description: If added to homepage later: dispatches CustomEvent testimonial-scroll from scroll handler to dot indicators. String-event anti-pattern invisible to React DevTools.
fix: Lift activeIndex state up to parent and pass as prop, OR use useState in parent.

description: If added to homepage later: tabIndex=0 on horizontally scrollable region correct for keyboard nav, but no keyboard arrow handler. Users can tab to carousel but cannot use arrow keys.
fix: Add onKeyDown handler for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to advance slides.

description: No alternates.languages and no i18n implemented (single <html lang=en>). Acceptable for v1.
fix: When adding i18n, emit alternates.languages and per-page hreflang link tags.

description: No verification field (Google Search Console, Bing, etc.). Easy win.
fix: Add verification: { google: '...', other: { 'msvalidate.01': '...' } } after registering site.

description: No metadataBase declared, so any relative OG image URL would be resolved against request URL.
fix: Add metadataBase: new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://hips.foundation') to layout metadata.

description: secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' || req.nextUrl.protocol === 'https:' - second branch means Secure on Vercel preview URLs. Good.
fix: OK as-is.

description: img-src 'self' data: https: blob: - wildcard over https:. Any image from any HTTPS source will be allowed.
fix: Restrict to known image hosts: https://images.unsplash.com https://hips-hsss.firebasestorage.app https://*.googleusercontent.com.

description: connect-src does not include https://api.stripe.com. Stripe.js POSTs telemetry to api.stripe.com on init - would be CSP-blocked in production on donate page.
fix: Add https://api.stripe.com to connect-src.

description: Error in root layout (e.g. font-loading crash) not caught by error.tsx. Next.js requires separate global-error.tsx at root for that.
fix: Add apps/web/src/app/global-error.tsx with minimal HTML document reset.

description: Middleware sets ?from=<pathname+search> on redirect to /login. If login page does not validate from is same-origin path, open-redirect surface.
fix: Audit /login and (auth)/login/page.tsx for from consumption; if used, validate with URL parsing and explicit check that from.startsWith('/') and does not start with //.

description: document.cookie = ${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=... - non-HttpOnly non-Secure client-set cookie for sidebar state.
fix: Add SameSite=Lax for hygiene. Not security-sensitive (UI only).

description: All four use dangerouslySetInnerHTML with JSON.stringify(jsonLd). JSON.stringify is safe against </script> injection only when closing tag also escaped.
fix: Inspect each component for </script> escaping. If not present, add .replace(/</g, '\\\\u003c') after JSON.stringify.

description: hipslogo.png loaded with priority and width/height 220x220, but actual rendered size on desktop is much smaller (logo CSS shrinks it).
fix: Drop priority (not LCP) and provide srcSet, OR use smaller intrinsic size like 80x80 with sizes=(max-width: 768px) 40px, 80px.

description: Buttons use hover:scale-[1.02] and active:scale-95. For prefers-reduced-motion these should be neutralized. Button class does not include motion-safe: on these.
fix: Wrap hover:scale with motion-safe:hover:scale-[1.02] etc.
